decisions.quote:
A logistic regression model confirmed the findings of McDonough
et al. (2015), with both L2 speaker and mutual eye gaze predictive of targetlike responses;
however, the effect of L2 speaker’s eye gaze duration was in the opposite direction as
compared to the initial study.
decisions.reason: The study set out to test two eye-gaze predictors from McDonough et al. (2015)—mutual gaze and L2 speaker gaze duration—and explicitly reports that while mutual gaze was confirmed, L2 speaker gaze duration was in the opposite direction (failed to reproduce the positive relationship), making the replication outcome mixed.
